This is medium, not high, confidence because it depends on decoding the fragment through the DSigDB source row. The fragment alone names no substance. Ranking pipelines should check that this row's gene set is that CTD term [https://www.ebi.ac.uk/chembl/api/data/molecule.json?molecule_structures__standard_inchi_key=GGCUJPCCTQNTJF-FRCNGJHJSA-N]

Do not confuse it with CHEMBL1169 AMINOSALICYLIC ACID, which is 4-aminosalicylic acid (PAS). The old first hit was correct.
